Pineapple compiles down to Pineapple Bytecode which is a form of pseduo-assembly (though I may make it compile down to ARM64 at some point), and uses its own virtual machine to execute the bytecode. Instead of using LLVM or other IRs, Pineapple is my attempt to write all of these the phases of a compiler from scratch, including virtual machine that will run the Pineapple Bytecode.
